news.title: ASX slumps as bond market rattles Wall Street; Unemployment hits 5-year high
news.snippet: The Australian sharemarket declined on Thursday, as oil prices rallied back over the $US100-a-barrel mark overnight and bond yields turned sharply higher.

news.title: Aureka adds gold processing firepower to Victorian push
news.snippet: Aureka Ltd has nominated a 30-year veteran metallurgist to its board ahead of a pivotal, low-cash deal that will deliver a producing Victorian gold mine and mill.

news.title: Manhattan opens up 1.25km Canadian gold corridor at Jaws
news.snippet: Manhattan Gold has hit 21.34m at 1.72g/t gold from a step-out hole in Canada, extending the strike at its Jaws prospect to 1.25km, with results for 10 holes remaining.

news.title: Macau hotel puts ClearVue solar glass tech to the test
news.snippet: ClearVue has launched the first real-world trial of its new power-generating window in Macau to test the tech’s energy and thermal benefits in a subtropical climate.

news.title: Sarytogan nails 452m of continuous copper in Kazakhstan
news.snippet: Sarytogan Graphite has bored a massive 452m copper intercept from surface at its Ilksan prospect in Kazakhstan, confirming a large-scale porphyry system at the project.

news.title: Lindian stacks ore as Malawian rare earths production nears
news.snippet: Lindian Resources has started stockpiling ore ahead of schedule at its Kangankunde rare earths mine in Malawi, where it is targeting first production by year-end.

news.title: Forrestania lifts WA British Hill gold resource past 210,000 ounces
news.snippet: Forrestania Resources has lifted its British Hill gold resource to 212,400 ounces, a 21 per cent increase that will feed into its two-hub WA gold production strategy.
